name: world-news
description: Major news from the Taiwan edition of Google News, pinned under your prompt: each time you send a message it reads the feeds of the categories you picked in the background (at most once per cooldown, 30 minutes by default) and shows the newest headline. /world-news picks the categories and the cooldown and lists the latest headlines. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
